capture_contract.comparison: Nominal H0 reference is a design input. No generalization claim.
capture_contract.handoff: sticky first pressure>50 after actual boostback cutoff, even if capture incomplete
capture_contract.reference: desired q/rate/alpha only; no r/v/fuel/actualactuator state initialization

capture_impulse_contract.application: subtract horizontal predicted thrust impulse from legacydesiredhorizontal then reapply existing700m/s cap before velocityerror/cutoff
capture_impulse_contract.assumed_cutoff: current time at each BB control evaluation
capture_impulse_contract.force: physical maxthrust times physical minimumthrottle; immediate ideal request approximation
capture_impulse_contract.mass: actual current mass minus ideal min-throttle center flow; no actual mass/state assignment
omitted_dynamics: gravity and atmosphere; compensates thrust impulse only
capture_impulse_contract.orientation: same desired-only reference, mapped from prospective cutoff; no actual future data

control_contract.faulty: A15s prospective ideal min-throttle center impulse is a local control feedforward, not achieved motion or admission. It uses actual current mass, installed available first center, physical Isp/thrust/minthrottle and desired-only reference orientation; no observed outcome bias. Finite pulse ends by actual v8guards; no state reset.
control_contract.healthy: Exact legacy commands and guide; all new corrections inactive.
control_contract.scope: Actual outage only. Restorev8boundedcapturepulse andsame-referenceTVCtail plus signedresidualRCS,50Pa handoff. Before legacyBBvelocityerror, subtract newly predicted capture horizontal impulse from desiredhorizontal, then recap700m/s. Keep original highq legacy vertical law above10km geodetic altitude; below use registered8m/s2 energy law.

interpretation.gate: Only two accepted saved-separation repair results from this same source/environment/profile/settings open a separate fresh-ground whole stage.
interpretation.invalid_or_budget: Stop entire stage on source/profile/site/goal/environment changes, invalid record, numerical or serialization/save/restore errors, output/disk/wall breach; no retry/resume.
interpretation.new_design: Diagnose preserved artifacts, then register a new sourcebound design if needed. Trial caps do not close the restoration project.
interpretation.valid_negative: Preserve unchanged negative and finish other registered case; do not tune or rerun within this design.
interpretation.whole_success: Report Ship, Booster, deployment and whole physical success separately. No AI/allfeatures/qualification claims.

powered_capture_contract.completion: actual measured fullq/rate gate, no ideal assignment
powered_capture_contract.incomplete: record timeout/reserve/noavailablecenter and end pulse, no retry
powered_capture_contract.main_throttle: installed center physical minimum .4; do not modify hardware
powered_capture_contract.shutdown: main OFF request after pulse, reference-tracked real tail while currentgimbalcapacity>physicalRCS, actual spool not erased
powered_capture_contract.time_step: Use unchanged powered_dt when actual pulse commands power, unchanged coast_dt otherwise; shorten current step at the fixed 15s guard, never integrate ON past the guard.

purpose: Keep fixed v8 finite capture pulse and signed residual RCS; compensate its prospective commanded horizontal impulse in boostback targeting, preserve old high-pressure guide until10km altitude, then replace only low-altitude vertical descent. Determine physical return with unchanged gates, not a counterfactual claim.
rationale: v9no-pulse met intermediatecapture label but later lost attitude. Retainv8fullposehistory and account for its planned translational sideeffect before adding that pulse; remove legacy terminal loiter below10km. No guarantee from current-input quadrature; only actual retained6DOF result opens whole.

residual_capture_contract.actual_jet_request: subtract actual main once, clip to available signed jet capacities, add main back for existing measured allocator to subtract once. Recenter mains through actual finite actuators; command all mainsOFF and hold actual fins.
residual_capture_contract.braking_budget: direction=-I*quaternion_error_axis; intersect actual signed jet box. If feedforward outside box set a_stop=0 and ff_feasible=false. a_stop shapes closing speed only, not the rate-correction acceleration clip.
residual_capture_contract.claims: current-state heuristic, not stopping guarantee, admission, qualification or achieved capture
residual_capture_contract.old_default: Preserve old v6/v7 default command and receipt arithmetic; newly source-bound execution records have their own source identity. Only this explicit setting selects the residual law.
residual_capture_contract.total_acceleration: reference feedforward+raw rate correction clipped to unchanged configured .03 component limits

retention: Keep source plans/claims/logs, original H0/O0 successes/negatives and all new outputs; archive/hash/readback/representative restore before later separately authorized cleanup. No public push, merge, Docker or worktree cleanup.
scope_limits: AI/image/symptom diagnosis/inflight approval/tower catch/arbitrary faults/qualification/develop/video are not included.
A valid original O0 negative is an admissible separation source; it is not required to have succeeded physically.
Contact is model geometry and controlled water-entry envelope only, not water response/postcontact support/real SpaceX qualification.

terminal_descent_contract.activation: actualfault and original landing phase and actual geodetic altitude<=10000m
terminal_descent_contract.clearance: actual finite cylinder hull clearance, never nominal COMaltitude
terminal_descent_contract.feedforward: -a*measured_COM_vertical_speed/reference_speed for nonnegative clearance; approximate because hull clearance rate includes angular and moving-CoM terms
terminal_descent_contract.parameter_kind: new explicit controller design assumption; not plant authority or calibrated physical value

unchanged: Pinned physical profile, hardware, inputmasses, thrust/Isp/fuel, integrationstepvalues and allcontact/reserve/watergates
Legacyhighpressure guide above10km; horizontaldamping15deg and3centerprefix; low-altitudevertical explicitlyreplaced
No actualstate assignment, hostedmodels, nested6DOF forecasts, towercatch, qualificationrefresh or publicrelease
